name: unsaved-changes-dialog
title: Unsaved changes dialog
description: The question before leaving a form with changes: Save, Discard or Keep editing, with a guard hook for link clicks, the Back button and the browser's own prompt.
docs: The dialog is only the question and useLeaveGuard(dirty) is the guard; either works alone. Spread guard.dialogProps onto the dialog and give it onSave: resolve true (or nothing) to save and leave, resolve false or throw to stay open and show why. Without onSave there are two answers and Discard turns solid. The guard catches a link click before your router and clicks the link again on leave; it catches Back with one extra history entry of its own; and it registers the browser's own prompt for closing the tab or reloading. A router.push from a button cannot be seen: wrap it in guard.request(() => router.push(url)). The extra entry has a cost: while there are changes the page is in the history twice, and a leave through a link or request first steps back off it (your router sees a Back to the same page), so the history stays page, next page.
